title: Assessment as a decision loop
caption: Assessment begins and ends with a decision. Feedback allows the plan to change.

title: Ethical assessment container
caption: Technical skill is held inside ethical responsibilities to the child and family.

title: Cultural formulation questions
caption: Culture is explored as a lived context, not a checklist or stereotype.

title: From construct to indicator
caption: A score is an indicator of a construct, not the construct itself.

title: Score interpretation ladder
caption: Each step adds meaning and uncertainty. The final step is a responsible decision.

title: Observed score, true score, and error
caption: Reliability describes how much error surrounds an observed score.

title: Validity evidence
caption: Validity is an argument built from multiple sources of evidence for a specific use.

title: Fairness safeguards
caption: Fairness requires safeguards across the whole assessment pathway.

title: Interview layers
caption: The interview is relational and purposeful at the same time.

title: ABC functional assessment
caption: Functional assessment links behavior to context and designs a matching support.

title: Cognitive demand match
caption: Behavior may reflect a mismatch between cognitive demands and supports.

title: Intellectual and adaptive assessment
caption: Intellectual assessment should be interpreted alongside daily functioning and context.

title: Multi-informant symptom assessment
caption: Different informants see different contexts. Discrepancies are data, not noise.

title: Expressive methods guardrails
caption: Expressive methods generate hypotheses and support relationship; they do not replace evidence.

title: Judgment and structure
caption: Structured prediction and feedback improve clinical judgment over time.

title: Screening errors
caption: Every screening decision has possible errors. Base rates shape predictive values.

title: Progress monitoring loop
caption: Monitoring turns assessment into an ongoing conversation with evidence.

title: Digital assessment safeguards
caption: Technology should expand understanding while protecting the young person.

title: Report to action
caption: A report is useful when it leads to understood and feasible action.

title: Integrated assessment
caption: Integrated assessment holds technical skill inside ethical and cultural responsibility.
